变体：法术值 Variant: Spell Points
　　改变职业感觉的一种方法是改变它使用法术的方式。在该变体系统下，一名具有“施法”特性的角色将使用法术值而不是法术位来作为法术的资源。法术值给予施法者更大的灵活性，却以复杂化为代价。
　　在该变体下，每个法术都有一个基于其环阶的成本值。表格“法术值消耗”总结了从1到9环阶法术的对应法术值成本。戏法不需要法术位因此也不需要消耗法术值。
　　你将获取一定数量的法术值代替所获得的各种法术位。随后，你将花费一定数量的法术值来创建一个指定环阶的法术位，然后使用该法术位来施展一个法术。你不能把你的法术值降低到少于0的数值，完成一次长休后，你将重新恢复所有已消耗的法术值。
　　6环或更高环阶的法术施法时耗费巨大。你可以使用法术值来创建一个6环或更高环阶的法术位。但此后直至完成一次长休前，你将无法再以此创造同样水平的法术位。
　　你需要使用的法术值的总量基于你的施法者等级，如表格“等级对应法术值”所示。你的等级同时也决定了你能创造的最高环阶法术位。而即使你可能有足够的法术值来创造高于该最大值的法术位，你也无法这样做。
　　表格“等级对应法术值”适用于吟游诗人、牧师、德鲁伊、术士和法师。当用于圣武士或游侠时，必须将角色的等级减半后再对应该表。而用于战士（奥法骑士Eidritch Knight）或游荡者（诡术师Arcane Trickster）时，则先将角色的等级除以三。
　　该系统也可以用于使用法术位施法的怪物，但并不推荐。事实上，跟进一只怪物的法术值其实相当麻烦。

Variant: Spell Points
One way to change how a class feels is to change how it uses spells. Under this variant system, a character with the Spellcasting feature uses spell points instead of spell slots as the resource for casting spells. Spell points give a spellcaster greater flexibility at the cost of complexity.
Under this variant, each spell has a cost based on its level. The Spell Point Cost table summarizes the costs for spells of levels 1 through 9. Cantrips don't require spell slots and therefore don't cost spell points.
You gain a pool of spell points instead of the various spell slots you would normally gain. You then spend spell points to create a spell slot of a specified level and use that slot to cast a spell. You can't reduce your spell points below 0, and you regain all expended spell points when you finish a Long Rest.
Spells of level 6 or higher are especially taxing to cast. You can use spell points to create a spell slot of level 6 or higher. Once you do, you can't create another slot of that same level this way until you finish a Long Rest.
Your total spell points are based on your spellcaster level, as shown in the Spell Points by Level table. Your level also determines the highest-level spell slot you can create. Even if you have enough spell points to create a slot above that maximum, you can't do so.
The Spell Points by Level table applies to Bards, Clerics, Druids, Sorcerers, and Wizards. For a Paladin or Ranger, halve the character's level before consulting the table. For a Fighter (Eldritch Knight) or Rogue (Arcane Trickster), first divide the character's level by three.
This system can also be used for monsters that cast spells using spell slots, but doing so isn't recommended. Keeping track of a monster's spell points is quite cumbersome.
